metadata.title: 129亿美元拟购Hugging Face：NVIDIA把竞争推向模型分发入口
metadata.titleEn: NVIDIA’s $12.9 Billion Hugging Face Deal Moves the Contest to Model Distribution
metadata.summary: 约119亿美元股东购买价与至多约10亿美元股权留任不能混作现金支出。交易若完成，NVIDIA将更接近模型发现、部署和推理路由的决策点；开放承诺能否变成可检验的平台中立性，将决定这笔分发投资的成败。
metadata.summaryEn: The proposed transaction separates roughly $11.9 billion for shareholders from an equity retention program of up to $1 billion. Its strategic value depends on converting model discovery into deployment while preserving a credible multi-hardware marketplace.
